dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures display irregular, crenulated outer perimeters with high-contrast light-grey edges; the pixel intensity shifts sharply from the dark dorsal background to the bright rim, with a secondary gradient transition toward a medium-grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid high-intensity white clusters without internal gradients, sparsely distributed across the mid-dorsal surface between larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form a wide-angled scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented towards the posterior-lateral cluster.
